title: Foundry usage rollup bills one account too much
summary: The nightly Foundry usage rollup reports higher compute-seconds than the dashboard for one account, and billing is paused until it is trusted.

company.notes: Foundry-shaped data-pipeline dedup problem; subtle logic flaw, no syntax error.

expected_output:
=== Compute-seconds by account ===
acme: 42
globex: 22
initech: 30
umbrella: 12
buggy_output:
=== Compute-seconds by account ===
acme: 82
globex: 22
initech: 30
umbrella: 12

phase2.spec_patch: Ops added a third replica stream, 'audit'. Its events must be folded into each account's compute-seconds, deduplicated by event_id the same way — an event on audit that also arrived on primary or backup is still one event.
phase2.expected_output_v2:
=== Compute-seconds by account ===
acme: 42
globex: 30
initech: 30
umbrella: 12
